The air crackled with the sheer voltage of the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, making his boots buzz against the metal grating. He managed to DEFEND his utility belt from a sudden magnetic surge with a quick pivot. Leaping over a sparking capacitor, he tossed a stray wrench to ATTRACT a lethal discharge away from the path. Without missing a beat, he shoved his hand into the exposed interface to CONSUME the raw kinetics, then bounded forward to thrust the glowing baton firmly into Kaio's hands.
